newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-NINE-MAN HAMBURG BEAT ST PAULI 3-0.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NINE-MAN HAMBURG BEAT ST PAULI 3-0.

text.p: Hamburg beat St Pauli 3-0 in the German first division on Sunday despite having two men sent off.
Defender Stefan Schnoor was dismissed in the fourth minute for a serious foul on Brazilian Emerson and midfielder Sven Kmetsch followed him on the hour for a second bookable offence.
In between, Karsten Baeron took advantage of a defensive error by Tore Pedersen to give Hamburg a first-half lead and Austrian international Markus Schopp added a second two minutes after the break.

Undaunted by the second dismissal, nine-man Hamburg wrapped up the three points with a goal from substitute striker Andre Breitenreiter, who scored with his first touch in the last minute of the match.
